summary.en: Volume-render one explicitly named point field and zero-based component of a field file, keeping negative and positive values; by default the diverging colormap is centred on 0. A result unit only relabels the field; values are never converted and no magnitude is computed.
summary.zh_CN: 对场文件中明确指定的点场及零起始分量做体渲染，保留正负值；默认发散色图以 0 为中心。结果单位只改写标签，不换算数值，也不计算模长。

purpose.en: Read the field file and build the volume.
purpose.zh_CN: 读取场文件并生成体数据。
离屏渲染 PNG 图像。

purpose.en: The PNG image needs offscreen OpenGL (EGL or OSMesa).
purpose.zh_CN: PNG 图像需要离屏 OpenGL（EGL 或 OSMesa）。
